declared: 2026-10-30, WP-11 Phase H follow-up, before any recycled Native run (the v1b single-process run native_reliability_v1b_001 was in progress, unscored)
purpose: Demonstrate the opt-in process-recycling mitigation (scripts/collect_dataset.py --recycle-every N) on Native. It is a mitigation for slow per-episode native memory growth, never a 'no leak' result, and it never sets or changes the Native POLICY_READY verdict (that is the v1b single-process run).

run.plan: configs/wp11/phaseG/native_reliability_trim_v1.json (the Phase G/H 4-episode Native Test F plan, fixed seed 42)
run.processes: 2 child processes (episodes 0-1, 2-3) under one parent that runs the C2 preflight once and scores the dataset
run.source: a fresh git worktree pinned at the commit that adds this file (git_dirty = false)
run.launch_conditions: only after native_reliability_v1b_001 has finished (one Isaac job of this agent at a time); a GPU with <= 2 other active jobs and >= 12 GB free; >= 17.5 GB free on /mnt/data at launch (15 GB floor + ~2.5 GB expected output); otherwise NOT_RUN with the reason
run.failure_policy: failed episodes and failed child processes are kept and reported; no rerun with changed settings

criteria.MITIGATION_DEMONSTRATED: all of: (1) both child processes ran and exited 0 with distinct pids; (2) episodes 0-3 stored with continuous ids, the plan's seeds, index rows in order, and read_dataset.py PASS on the whole dataset; (3) every per-episode v1b check passes (reset isolation, grasp re-stabilization, clocks, cameras, storage, expected outcomes); (4) the host RSS after the first episode of block 1 is within 64 MiB (one v1a per-episode allowance) of the host RSS after the first episode of block 0
criteria.memory_reporting: per-process host RSS / GPU series and per-block slopes are reported (dataset.reliability_report memory.per_process); the whole-run slope across processes is a sawtooth by construction and is reported but not interpreted; with 2 episodes per process no within-process slope is fitted (fit_from_episode 1 leaves 1 point)
criteria.not_claimed: no leak absence, no POLICY_READY verdict, no statement about runs longer than 4 episodes
